svg.text: The same 16 steps as Figure 1. Inside each step: the parts of the system that do it, from left to right.
Author: Md. Abdul Kahhar Siddiki Shan
Describe the job in the Assistant chat
The AI writes the job description
Post the job with the form link
Read, score and rank every CV
Fetch applications or upload a CV
Join the call and check identity
Live transcript and the AI Helper
Check each answer and the interview
The Dashboard counts every job, CV, interview and report (code, no
AI). One log file: every API call and every AI call with its tokens
The AI only suggests. A person approves and posts the job, sends
emails, shortlists and decides. Candidates never see scores, notes or
the helper. Every AI quote is checked against the CV or the
JWT for interviewers; candidates use a private link
connection checks, AI model choice, workflow log
API calls and AI calls with tokens, Bangladesh time
